info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management

description.describe_ch: 提供研究所學生對高等生產系統及服務管理、供應鏈管理之理論基礎，訓練其模式建構能力，並於課程中使學生熟悉以電腦為主的實做工具。課程中亦強調溝通能力及團隊工作能力之訓練。
description.describe_eh:
Provide the graduate students with fundamental theories regarding contemporary Production and
operations management, and supply chain, as well as the ability of model construction. Students are
required to familiarize themselves with some computer based development tools. The class also
emphasizes communication skills and team works.
